visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young man with dark hair styled in a center part, wearing a black t-shirt, stands in front of a neutral backdrop of closed gray vertical-pleated curtains. He is positioned in a medium close-up, speaking directly and expressively toward the camera with occasional hand gestures just below the frame. (2) The visual transitions to a top-down view of a large, framed poster on a wooden floor. The poster depicts a large, green, segmented creature (an Ohm) with many blue eyes. A man's hand enters the frame periodically to point at specific details on the poster's matte surface under soft indoor lighting. (3) The camera moves closer for an extreme close-up of the creature's eyes on the poster, showing a reflective coating. A physical green model of the same creature is placed beside the poster for direct visual comparison. The hand points at both the model and the poster eyes to show size differences. (4) The hand begins flipping through several individual animation cels or prints protected by clear plastic sleeves. These drawings show the same creature in different poses and colors, including red-eyed versions. The background remains the wooden floor and the edge of the framed poster. (5) The shot focuses on the stylized black title text '風之谷' on the bottom corner of the poster. A manga book is held next to it to contrast the different font designs. The hand points out the small 'eye' design incorporated into the poster's version of the title characters.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) A calm, friendly male voice begins speaking in Mandarin, introducing the content. A low-tempo, Lo-fi background track with a soft melodic piano line and steady electronic beat starts. The voice maintains a moderate speech rate and clear articulation. (2) As the subject shifts to a physical poster, the narration continues with consistent energy. Audible rustling sounds of paper and the faint crinkling of plastic sleeves are heard as items are manipulated on a hard surface. The BGM remains constant in the background. (3) The speaker's pitch rises slightly as he identifies specific design details. Frequent, rhythmic rustling noises occur as pages of original artwork are flipped. The interaction between the enthusiastic vocal delivery and the consistent BGM creates an informative and engaging acoustic atmosphere. (4) The audio phase concludes with a final technical explanation of typography. The male voice uses a stable, slightly lower pitch for emphasis. The ambient background music continues until the end, accompanied by the last few sounds of objects being placed down.

narrative_and_purpose.narrativeStructure: Linear: Hook -> Presentation -> Comparative Analysis -> Detail Highlight -> Conclusion.
narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video serves to unbox and review a special limited edition poster from 'Nausicaä of the Valley of the Wind'. It focuses on highlighting specific artistic choices, such as the eye proportions and unique typography, by comparing the poster to a physical model and original animation cels.

endorsement_analysis.endorsementCues: The content appears to be a personal collection showcase rather than a commercial promotion.

high_inference.freeDescribe: The video features high production value in its close-up photography of the artwork, emphasizing the texture and reflective properties of the poster's print.
